Area A = π/4 × (D² − d²).
Theoretical weight = A × length × density.
参考密度不是材料验收值；牌号、公差、涂层会影响实际重量。: Reference density is not a material acceptance value. Grade, tolerances and coatings affect actual weight.
中心距：两个连接管件中心线交点之间的距离。: Center distance: the distance between the two fitting centerline intersections.
中心至端面：从管件中心线交点量到焊口或连接端面的距离。: Center-to-end: the distance from the fitting centerline intersection to its connection face.
不同标准、压力等级、系列和厂家尺寸可能不同，应以现场实物或厂家资料为准。: Dimensions vary by standard, pressure class and manufacturer. Use actual fittings or manufacturer data.
单位是否一致，英制与公制没有混用: Use consistent units; do not mix metric and imperial.
测量基准点是否都是中心线或端面: Confirm whether reference points are centerlines or faces.
弯头角度、方向和滚动面是否正确: Check elbow angle, direction and roll plane.
左右管件扣除尺寸是否分别核对: Check the fitting take-off at each end.
保温、坡口、焊缝收缩或安装余量是否另行考虑: Allow separately for insulation, bevels, weld shrinkage and installation.
